title: Investigation on the mechanisms of guiqi huoxue capsule for treating cervical spondylosis based on network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: Liu, Yingying; Zhang, Jingyuan; Liu, Xinkui; Zhou, Wei; Stalin, Antony; Fu, Changgeng; Wu, Jiarui; Cheng, Guoliang; Guo, Siyu; Jia, Shanshan; Li, Bingbing; Wang, Haojia; Li, Jialin; Lu, Shan
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究芪归活血胶囊治疗颈椎病的机制，对象为药物-蛋白-疾病通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Guiqi huoxue capsule (GQHXC) is a patented Chinese medicine used for treating a liver and kidney deficiency and blood stasis syndrome due to qi deficiency. It is caused by cervical spondylosis (cervical spondylotic radiculopathy (CSR), mixed cervical spondylosis mainly composed of nerve root type). Its underlying mechanisms need, however, to be further clarified. METHODS: In this study, collecting compounds, predicting therapeutic targets, constructing networks, and analyzing biological functions and pathways were based on network pharmacology analysis. In addition, molecular docking verification was engaged to assess the binding potential of selected target-compound pairs. RESULTS: We established 5 networks: compound-putative target network of GQHXC, protein-protein interaction (PPI) network related to CSR, compound-CSR target network, potential therapeutic targets PPI network, and herb-compound-target-pathway network. Network analysis indicated that 7 targets (tumor necrosis factor [TNF], interleukin 6 [IL6], nitric oxide synthase 3 [NOS3], Interleukin-8 [CXCL8], prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2 [PTGS2], vascular endothelial growth factor A [VEGFA], and AP-1 transcription factor subunit [JUN]) might be the therapeutic targets of GQHXC in CSR. Moreover, molecular docking verification showed that TNF, IL6, NOS3, CXCL8, PTGS2, VEGFA, and JUN had a good is interaction with the corresponding compounds. Furthermore, enrichment analysis indicated that GQHXC might exert a curative role in CSR by regulating some important pathways, such as TNF signaling pathway, NF-kappa B signaling pathway, AGE-RAGE signaling pathway in diabetic complications, and so on. CONCLUSION: Our study preliminarily explained the underlying mechanisms of GQHXC for treating CSR, and molecular docking verification was adopted as an additional verification. These findings laid a valuable foundation for experimental research and further application of GQHXC in the clinical treatment of CSR.
abstract_zh: 背景：芪归活血胶囊（GQHXC）是一种专利中药，用于治疗因气虚导致肝肾亏虚、血瘀证，该证由颈椎病（神经根型颈椎病（CSR）、以神经根型为主的混合型颈椎病）引起。然而，其潜在机制仍需进一步阐明。方法：本研究基于网络药理学分析，包括收集化合物、预测治疗靶点、构建网络以及分析生物学功能和通路。此外，采用分子对接验证评估所选靶点-化合物对的结合潜力。结果：我们构建了5个网络：GQHXC的化合物-推定靶点网络、与CSR相关的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络、化合物-CSR靶点网络、潜在治疗靶点PPI网络以及草药-化合物-靶点-通路网络。网络分析表明，7个靶点（肿瘤坏死因子 [TNF]、白细胞介素6 [IL6]、一氧化氮合酶3 [NOS3]、白细胞介素-8 [CXCL8]、前列腺素内过氧化物合酶2 [PTGS2]、血管内皮生长因子A [VEGFA] 和AP-1转录因子亚基 [JUN]）可能是GQHXC治疗CSR的靶点。此外，分子对接验证显示，TNF、IL6、NOS3、CXCL8、PTGS2、VEGFA和JUN与相应化合物具有良好的相互作用。进一步富集分析表明，GQHXC可能通过调节一些重要通路，如TNF信号通路、NF-kappa B信号通路、糖尿病并发症中的AGE-RAGE信号通路等，在CSR中发挥治疗作用。结论：本研究初步阐明了GQHXC治疗CSR的潜在机制，并采用分子对接验证作为额外验证。这些发现为GQHXC在CSR临床治疗中的实验研究和进一步应用奠定了有价值的基础。
